full.summary: Brush the stone and directly drag windbreaks and flowers.

simplified.summary: Clear moss with its visible proxy; click rails to set windbreak targets, and click flowers then destination points. Identical inertia, draft, geometry and outcomes.

interaction_notes.shared_world: At the same difficulty and seed, both modes retain the same draft, shield response, geometry and outcome rules. D1 uses direct shield positioning; D2-D5 use inertia. The mode summaries' identical outcomes refer to those physical rules, not identical concurrent input affordances.
interaction_notes.flower_input_resource: Flowers exist only at D3-D5. Full mode occupies the pointer while carrying a flower, so it must be released or cancelled before adjusting a shield. Simplified mode retains a selected flower while allowing a shield target click. This intentional input-resource simplification does not pause or change the world physics. D1-D2 have no flower selection or carrying state.
